question: The sum of the ages of a daughter and her mother is 56 years. After 8 years, the age of the mother will be three times that of the daughter. Find the daughter's present age (in years).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let daughter = D, mother = M

M + D = 56

After 8 yrs ⇒ M + 8 = 3(D + 8)

⇒ M = 3D + 16

Put in sum ⇒ 3D + 16 + D = 56 ⇒ 4D = 40 ⇒ D = 10

**∴ Answer = 10 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of ages = 56; After 8 years: Mother = 3 × Daughter

**Formula used:**

Linear equations

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let daughter’s age = x

⇒ Mother’s age = 56 − x

⇒ After 8 years: 56 − x + 8 = 3(x + 8)

⇒ 64 − x = 3x + 24

⇒ 64 − 24 = 3x + x

⇒ 40 = 4x

⇒ x = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**
